title: Innkeeper
motivations: find out who keeps stealing the spoons
greet: 'Sit, sit! You look like you've walked through a hedge backwards.'
'Rooms are three silver. Stew is free if you don't ask what's in it.'
ask: 'Rats in the cellar again. Big ones.'
'My delivery cart never arrived. Could you look?'
pleased: 'Ha! I knew you lot had it in you. Drinks are on me.'
'Bless you. Come back any time, the door's always open.'
displeased: 'Hmph. And I gave you the good table.'
'Out. Mind the step on your way.'

title: Blacksmith
motivations: get rare ore from the mountains
pay off a debt to the guild
greet: 'Mind the anvil. And the sparks. And the dog.'
'If it's broken, I fix it. If it's not, I'll sell you a better one.'
ask: 'Bring me star-iron from the old mine and I'll make you something special.'
pleased: 'Now that's the kind of grit I respect.'
'Fine. I'll put you at the front of the queue.'
displeased: 'Talk is cheap. Steel isn't.'
'Don't let the anvil hit you on the way out.'

title: Hermit
motivations: warn the world about a coming darkness
greet: 'Visitors. Hmph. Wipe your feet on the moss.'
'I saw you coming three days ago. In a dream. You were taller.'
ask: 'The spirits are restless. Something in the ruins has woken.'
pleased: 'Hm. Perhaps the dream was right about you.'
'Take this road. The spirits will not trouble you.'
displeased: 'Leave. The moss and I prefer the quiet.'
'I knew this would happen. I dreamed it.'

title: Travelling Merchant
motivations: find a buyer for a cursed item
greet: 'Friends! Customers! Friends who are customers!'
'Everything must go. Some of it is even legal.'
ask: 'Escort me through the pass and I'll make it worth your while.'
pleased: 'A pleasure doing business! Truly!'
'For you, my friends, a very special price.'
displeased: 'No sale. Next customer, please!'
'I've been swindled by better than you.'

title: Noble
greet: 'Adventurers. How... rustic.'
'You may approach. Not too close.'
ask: 'My heirloom ring was stolen by brigands. Retrieve it, discreetly.'
pleased: 'How delightful. You may call on me again.'
'Very well. You have my favour, for now.'
displeased: 'Guards, see these people out.'
'How tedious. I expected so much more.'

title: Guard Captain
motivations: keep the peace with too few soldiers
greet: 'State your business. Quickly — I've got three fires and a goat riot.'
ask: 'Bandits on the east road. I can't spare a single soldier. You, though...'
pleased: 'Good. The realm could use more like you.'
'You've earned my trust. Don't waste it.'
displeased: 'Move along before I find a reason.'
'One more word and you'll sleep in a cell.'

title: Priest
motivations: protect the town from the undead
greet: 'Blessings upon you. You look like you need several.'
ask: 'The old graveyard is... restless. Please, put them back to sleep.'
pleased: 'The light shines on you today, friends.'
'Go with my blessing, and my thanks.'
displeased: 'I will pray for you. You need it.'
'The gods are patient. I am less so.'

title: Rival Bard
motivations: be more famous than the party
write the ballad of the century
greet: 'Oh, it's YOU. I suppose they'll write songs about you too. Short ones.'
ask: 'Do something heroic. I need material.'
pleased: 'Fine! You may have the encore. This once.'
'I'll write you into my next ballad. A small part.'
displeased: 'Dreadful. Simply dreadful. No rhythm at all.'
'I've heard better from a drunken goose.'

title: Pickpocket
motivations: pull off one last big job
greet: 'Psst. Nice purse. Shame if someone... complimented it.'
ask: 'Help me lift a ledger from the tax office. For the people. And for me.'
pleased: 'Alright, alright. You're alright, you are.'
'I like you. Here's a secret for free.'
displeased: 'Nice try. My pockets are faster than your mouth.'
'I was never here. Neither were you.'

title: Farmer
motivations: get rid of whatever's in the barn
greet: 'You lot aren't from the tax office, are you?'
ask: 'Something's been eating my sheep. Something BIG.'
pleased: 'Oh, you're a good sort! Have a turnip.'
'Thank you kindly. The harvest is saved.'
displeased: 'City folk. Always talking.'
'Off my field, the lot of you.'

title: Hedge Witch
motivations: settle an old score with a rival hag
greet: 'Come in, dearies. Don't touch the jars. Especially that one.'
ask: 'Fetch me a moonpetal from the haunted glade and I'll brew you something nice.'
pleased: 'Clever little ducks! Have a biscuit. Probably safe.'
'Oh, I like you. I won't turn you into anything.'
displeased: 'Tsk. I've turned people into toads for less.'
'Shoo, shoo. My cauldron needs the quiet.'

title: Knight-Errant
motivations: prove their courage after a disgrace
greet: 'Hail, fellow travellers! Have you seen a dragon? Or a horse?'
ask: 'Join me on a glorious quest! It's mostly glorious.'
pleased: 'Huzzah! Together we ride for glory!'
'You have the hearts of true knights.'
displeased: 'Have you no honour at all?'
'I shall pretend I did not hear that.'

title: Scholar
greet: 'Fascinating. Are you a specimen or a visitor?'
ask: 'Copy the inscriptions in the ruins for me. Carefully. Accurately. Please.'
pleased: 'Fascinating! Truly a remarkable argument.'
'I must write this down. You may borrow my notes.'
displeased: 'Your logic is, frankly, embarrassing.'
'Please leave. You're standing on my research.'

title: Ranger
greet: 'You walk like a herd of cattle. Follow me — quietly.'
ask: 'There's a beast in the woods killing everything. Help me hunt it.'
pleased: 'You'll do. Follow my tracks.'
'The wild trusts you. So will I.'
displeased: 'Too loud. You'd scare off a deaf boar.'
'Go back to the road where you belong.'

title: Fortune Teller
motivations: see the end of a prophecy
warn the party of their fate
greet: 'Sit. Cross my palm with silver. The cards are... troubled.'
ask: 'Find the one whose face is on this card. Before it's too late.'
pleased: 'The cards smile on you, my dears.'
'Ah, a bright future. Brighter than most.'
displeased: 'The cards say no. And so do I.'
'I see a short future. Very short.'

title: Alchemist
motivations: find a cure for a plague
greet: 'Don't mind the smoke. Or the smell. Or the screaming. That's normal.'
ask: 'I need troll fat. Fresh. Ideally still attached.'
pleased: 'Eureka! You've solved it! Well, I have, but thank you!'
'Take a potion. It only glows a little.'
displeased: 'Careful! That's flammable. So is my temper.'
'Out, before something explodes. Possibly you.'

title: Lost Child
greet: 'Are you heroes? You look like heroes. Mostly.'
ask: 'Can you help me find my way home? It's past the scary woods.'
pleased: 'Really? You'll help me? Thank you!'
'You're the best heroes ever!'
displeased: 'You're mean! I'm telling!'
'I don't like you. Go away.'

title: Restless Ghost
greet: 'Oooh... you can see me? Finally!'
ask: 'Find my locket and bury it with my bones. Please.'
pleased: 'At last... someone listens...'
'Thank you... I can almost rest...'
displeased: 'Leave me... to my sorrow...'
'You are... no different from the rest...'

title: Talking Animal
motivations: be turned back into a person
greet: 'Yes, I can talk. No, I won't do tricks.'
ask: 'Find the wizard who did this to me. I have WORDS for them.'
pleased: 'Splendid! I knew you were clever, for humans.'
'Very well. Follow me, and do keep up.'
displeased: 'Hmph. I've met smarter sheep.'
'I shall ignore you now. Dramatically.'

title: Retired Adventurer
motivations: warn the young about a dungeon
greet: 'Back in my day we fought dragons uphill. Both ways.'
ask: 'My old party left something in the crypt. I'm too old. You're not.'
pleased: 'Ha! Reminds me of my old crew.'
'You've got spark. Don't let anyone snuff it.'
displeased: 'In my day, heroes had manners.'
'You'll be dead in a week. Mark my words.'

title: Smuggler
motivations: get revenge on a mutinous crew
greet: 'Ahoy. You're not navy, are ye? Good. Drink?'
ask: 'Help me get my cargo past the patrol and you'll have a share.'
pleased: 'Har! You've got salt in your blood, friend.'
'Welcome aboard, mateys.'
displeased: 'Walk the plank. Oh wait, we're on land.'
'Off with ye, landlubbers.'

title: Tax Collector
greet: 'Adventurers? Then you have income. Then you have taxes.'
ask: 'The tax chest was stolen. If you return it... I'll forget your arrears.'
pleased: 'Your paperwork is in order. Remarkable.'
'Very well. I'll overlook a small discrepancy.'
displeased: 'That will be a fine. A large one.'
'Noted. In red ink.'

title: Cult Defector
motivations: stop the ritual from the inside
greet: 'Shh! They're looking for me. I know things. Useful things.'
ask: 'Get me to safety and I'll tell you how to weaken the enemy.'
pleased: 'Thank you. I knew I was right to run.'
'Then I'll tell you everything. Everything.'
displeased: 'You're just like them. I should never have come.'
'Forget you saw me. Please.'

title: Miner
greet: 'Mind your heads. Mind your feet. Mind everything, really.'
ask: 'My crew is trapped below. Something's down there with them.'
pleased: 'Ha! Solid as bedrock, you are.'
'Come, I'll show you a seam of real silver.'
displeased: 'Bah. Softer than sandstone, the lot of you.'
'Back to the surface with you.'
